verdict.rationale: The axis applies because the RTX 5070 Ti ships within NVIDIA's developer ecosystem (CUDA Toolkit, SDKs), so API versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions for a buyer. The pack only shows a release version label ("CUDA 13.4") and never documents an API versioning scheme or a deprecation policy. The probes found no OpenAPI spec, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
